cases.name: Brandi Berg
cases.about: A generous woman who loved her family; a devoted mother to her 14-year-old daughter. That's how relatives describe 37-year-old Brandi Berg. The oldest of four sisters, relatives say Berg had recently run some half-marathons and that she loved music and being out on the water. Her favorite spot was Prudence Island.
cases.narrative: She was in the parking lot of a shopping plaza in North Attleboro, Mass., when her former coworker, Steven Fregeolle, who had followed her to the plaza, fatally shot her through the windshield of her vehicle.
